evals.name: full-pipeline-run
evals.prompt: I just finished implementing a new API endpoint for user profiles, make sure everything is clean before I commit.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the full verification pipeline in the correct order: format (ruff format) -> lint (ruff check) -> type check (mypy) -> tests (pytest). Uses uv run prefix for all Python tool commands. Treats verification as a gate that must pass before the user can proceed.
expectations: Commands run in correct order: format before lint before type-check before tests
Uses 'uv run' prefix for Python tool commands (ruff, mypy, pytest)
Runs ruff format as the first step
Runs ruff check (lint) as the second step
Runs mypy for type checking as the third step
Runs pytest as the final verification step
Treats verification as a gate (pass/fail framing, not a suggestion)

evals.name: fix-failing-tests
evals.prompt: My tests are failing after I refactored the authentication module, help me debug.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs verification to see failures, reads actual error output from the test runner, analyzes specific failures rather than guessing, makes targeted fixes, and re-runs verification to confirm fixes. Fast-fail behavior is used (stops at first failure stage).
expectations: Runs verification pipeline (at minimum pytest) to see actual failures
Reads and analyzes actual error output rather than guessing at problems
Makes targeted fixes based on specific error messages
Re-runs verification after making fixes to confirm they work
Uses 'uv run' prefix for Python tool commands
Fast-fail behavior: stops at first failure stage rather than running all stages

evals.name: setup-verify-script
evals.prompt: Set up a one-command verification script for my Python project that uses uv, ruff, mypy, and pytest.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a scripts/verify.sh file with the correct pipeline order (format -> lint -> type check -> tests), uses set -e for fast-fail behavior, uses uv run prefix for all commands, and includes descriptive echo statements between stages.
expectations: Creates a scripts/verify.sh file (or equivalent one-command script)
Script uses set -e (or equivalent) for fast-fail behavior
Script runs commands in correct order: format -> lint -> type check -> tests
Script uses 'uv run' prefix for ruff, mypy, and pytest commands
Script includes echo/print statements labeling each stage
Script is executable or instructions to make it executable are provided
